Enjoy The Best Experience
Nestled in the enchanting wilderness of Ranthambhore, Jungle Vilas resort stands as a haven of luxury, comfort, and warm hospitality for travelers seeking a perfect blend of nature and elegance. Located close to the world-famous Ranthambhore National Park, home to the majestic Royal Bengal Tiger, our resort is designed to provide guests with an unforgettable experience amidst the beauty of nature while ensuring world-class comfort.
At Jungle Vilas, our motto is simple yet powerful — “Excellence in Service and High-Quality Hospitality, Redefined.” We strive to set new standards in hospitality by offering an environment where modern comfort seamlessly blends with traditional Indian warmth. Every corner of Jungle Vilas reflects sophistication, tranquility, and a deep connection to nature. It’s not just a place to stay — it’s a destination that captures the essence of Ranthambhore’s spirit.
Ranthambore National Park
WELCOME TO JUNGLE VILAS
Where Hospitality Meets Expectations in the Land of the Royal Bengal Tiger, Ranthambhore
Ranthambhore is world-famous as the land of the Royal Bengal Tiger , and Jungle Vilas is perfectly positioned to help you explore the magic of this extraordinary landscape. Whether you are here for an exciting jungle safari, a relaxing getaway, or a cultural experience, our resort ensures comfort, convenience, and warm hospitality at every step.
A Perfect Blend of Comfort and Luxury
Jungle Vilas has been thoughtfully designed to meet the expectations of both nature enthusiasts and luxury seekers. Surrounded by lush greenery, the resort features beautifully appointed rooms &  cottages  that offer a serene view of the jungle landscape. Each accommodation unit is equipped with all modern amenities — plush bedding, air conditioning, elegant interiors, and spacious bathrooms — ensuring a stay that is both comfortable and indulgent.
The resort’s architecture draws inspiration from traditional Rajasthani design while incorporating modern aesthetics. The warm tones, handcrafted décor, and use of natural materials create a soothing ambiance that complements the rustic charm of Ranthambhore. Whether you are lounging by the pool, enjoying a quiet evening on your private balcony, or relaxing in our garden spaces, Jungle Vilas ensures a sense of peace and rejuvenation throughout your stay.
ROOMS
Deluxe Room​
The Deluxe Rooms at Jungle Vilas are designed to offer comfort, convenience, and value while maintaining a touch of elegance. These rooms provide a peaceful retreat with a partial view of the Aravalli range and the lush green surroundings of the resort. Thoughtfully furnished with modern amenities, soft lighting, and soothing décor, the Deluxe Rooms ensure a relaxing stay after a long day of exploration or safari. Perfect for families, couples, and solo travelers, this category combines affordability with quality, making your stay both enjoyable and memorable. Experience comfort, charm, and tranquility in every moment at Jungle Vilas.
Pool Facing Deluxe Room
The Pool Facing Deluxe Rooms at Jungle Vilas offer the perfect combination of comfort, elegance, and scenic beauty. Designed for guests who appreciate luxury with a view, these rooms overlook the region’s largest swimming pool, creating a refreshing and vibrant atmosphere throughout your stay. Each room features modern amenities, tasteful interiors, and a relaxing ambiance that ensures complete comfort. Wake up to the soothing sight of shimmering blue water and unwind on your private balcony or sit-out area. Ideal for couples, families, and leisure travelers, the Pool Facing Deluxe Rooms promise a delightful and memorable stay at Jungle Vilas.
Premium Cottages
The Premium Cottages at Jungle Vilas offer an exceptional blend of luxury, privacy, and natural beauty, making them the ideal choice for guests seeking an elevated stay experience in Ranthambhore. Thoughtfully designed with elegant interiors and modern comforts, these cottages provide a serene retreat surrounded by lush greenery and tranquil wilderness. Each cottage features spacious rooms, refined décor, plush bedding, and a private sit-out area where you can relax and enjoy the peaceful jungle ambiance. Whether you're planning a romantic getaway or a relaxing escape, the Premium Cottages promise unmatched comfort, exclusivity, and a truly memorable stay at Jungle Vilas.

Happy Stays
Kimora
Jungle Vilas is a perfect blend of luxury and nature. The rooms are elegant, the staff is genuinely warm, and the food is excellent. The pool and green surroundings add so much peace. Its location near the safari makes it ideal for wildlife lovers. Truly a memorable stay!
7 Days Ago
Ashleigh
Our experience at Jungle Vilas was amazing. The hospitality felt personal and heartfelt. The rooms were clean, spacious, and beautifully designed. The live cooking and delicious meals were highlights. A great place to relax after an adventurous safari. Highly recommended for families and couples visiting Ranthambhore!
2 Days Ago
James
Jungle Vilas is an outstanding resort that perfectly combines luxury, comfort, and the beauty of Ranthambhore’s wilderness. The rooms are spacious, beautifully designed, and provide complete relaxation after a safari. The staff is exceptionally warm and attentive, always ready to help with a smile.
4 Days Ago
